# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Blames Adam for His Fall

---

**7:1** 'And because of you, Adam, I was cast down from the heavens onto this earth, and my grief is upon you.'

**7:2** And Adam said to him: 'What is my blame? For it was not I who did this, but God alone. Why have you set your evil on me?'

**7:3** And the devil answered: 'I have set my evil on you because it is through you that I was expelled. And God, your Lord, has given you all things and created all things for your sake. And it is because of you that I was expelled and exiled from my dwelling.'

**7:4** 'When you were set in paradise, I was cast outside. And I said in my heart: "If he is set up in bliss while I am in exile and grief, I will make him suffer, that he also may be exiled as I am."'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
